stories.head: True Anomaly secures $190M for co-orbital security
stories.body: True Anomaly has raised a $190 million Series C round, bringing its valuation to $1.6 billion. The funding will bolster its capabilities in co-orbital security and space domain awareness, aligning with increasing DoD interest in these areas. It's a clear signal that cash is king, especially when the government is the client.
stories.soWhat: In a sector where innovation often takes a backseat to cash flow, True Anomaly's funding underscores the importance of securing government contracts over flashy tech.

stories.head: Spire teams with Diehl for missile warning systems
stories.body: Spire has announced a partnership with German defense firm Diehl Defence to develop space-based missile warning systems. This collaboration highlights the ongoing arms race in space, with both companies aiming to leverage satellite data for enhanced military capabilities. The deal reflects a growing trend of defense firms looking skyward for solutions.
stories.soWhat: As the space arms race heats up, partnerships like this may become the norm rather than the exception, raising questions about the implications for global security.

stories.head: Applied Atomics enters US market with $4M funding
stories.body: UK-based Applied Atomics is making a move into the U.S. military space mobility market, backed by $4 million in pre-seed funding. The startup aims to capitalize on the lucrative defense contracts available in the U.S., suggesting that the allure of American defense spending is too tempting for foreign startups to resist.
stories.soWhat: This trend of foreign startups entering the U.S. market could lead to increased competition and innovation, but also raises questions about regulatory hurdles and national security.

watchlist.title: Keep an eye on the FY27 budget
watchlist.body: The recent $1.4 billion increase for space resilience in the FY27 budget could shift priorities and funding flows in the coming weeks.

watchlist.title: Watch for more defense partnerships
watchlist.body: With Spire's new deal, expect more defense firms to seek partnerships in space-based technologies as military needs evolve.

watchlist.title: True Anomaly's next moves
watchlist.body: After securing significant funding, True Anomaly's strategic decisions will be closely watched for signs of how it plans to deploy its resources.

talent.statLabel: Job orders YoY · plus 2 starters per head, an 8-year first
talent.head: Demand has doubled. So has our hit rate.
talent.body: EVONA's job orders are up 2.0× year-over-year, and for the first time in our eight-year history we're placing two new starters per EVONA staff member. The first number says demand is real. The second says we're converting it, which in recruitment is the only number that actually matters. Growth is heaviest in Series B/C startups; primes are running flat. Compensation isn't the variable. The constraint is schedule risk in the primes: senior engineers leave Boeing, Lockheed, Northrop because they want to ship hardware before retirement.
